source: Dino 8 Master Plan Revision 2, Appendix B (Unified performance budgets); rule 'any benchmark regression more than 3% blocks merge' is section 9.1
note: Only rows a kernel CI job can measure are listed. 'gate' entries are the Appendix B numbers and count as misses; 'indicative' entries scale a gate to the smaller synthetic dataset and are printed but never fail. The 20-view section gate is stated for parallel views; the harness runs them serially, which is stricter.

NURBS boolean 1,000 faces under 1 s, scaled linearly
Section or elevation regeneration: under 1 s per view (necessary, not sufficient: the row names 50,000-element views)
20 views in parallel under 3 s (measured serially)
Undo or redo under 30 ms (kernel-side snapshot copy only)
Mesh boolean, two 1 M-triangle meshes under 2 s, scaled linearly to the dataset size
